title: Unnormalized dot-product attention suffers from vanishing gradients for large key dimensions
description: Without the scaling factor, dot-product attention pushes the softmax into regions with extremely small gradients when keys have high dimensionality. This motivated the scaled dot-product attention used in the Transformer.
canonical_description: dot-product attention without scaling suffers from vanishing gradients for large key dimensions

evidence.quote: additive attention outperforms dot product attention without scaling for larger values of d_k. We suspect that for large values of d_k, the dot products grow large in magnitude, pushing the softmax function into regions where it has extremely small gradients. To counteract this effect, we scale the dot products by 1/sqrt(d_k).
